name: gta6-clipper
description: Turn a long game reaction stream into ready-to-post vertical clips, automatically. Audio-only download, local transcription, loudness and chat detection, pluggable LLM scoring (opencode, claude, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), facecam detection, 1080x1920 renders with captions and hashtags.
author: NakhulGithesh

commands.doctor: report what is missing with the fix command
commands.clip: clip one stream by URL (finished VOD)
commands.auto-clip: find today's biggest streams and clip them
commands.live: record a live stream for a duration, then clip it

backends.claude: Claude Code CLI, subscription, best picks
backends.openai: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LM Studio, llama.cpp, Ollama /v1, vLLM)
backends.cmd: any shell command with {prompt}, e.g. cmd:'ollama run qwen3.5:27b {prompt}'
